name: Distancing: is said to, is believed to have, it is thought that
subtitle: Report structures show that a claim comes from other people, not from you: It is said that he is rich. He is said to be rich. The infinitive shows the time: to be (now), to be working (in progress), to have left (earlier).

flow.text: to be / to be doing / to have done

concept.exampleHtml: It is said that she lives abroad. — She is said to live abroad. — She is said to have left last year.

qa.html: Why use them? They report what people say or think, and they do not say that it is true. The writer keeps a distance. This is typical of news, reports and academic writing: The factory is believed to employ 500 people.

Two patterns. Impersonal: It is said / believed / thought / reported / claimed / expected that + a normal clause: It is believed that the thief used a ladder. Personal: the subject of the clause moves to the front and the verb becomes an infinitive: The thief is believed to have used a ladder. Both patterns mean the same.

The infinitive shows the time. to be / to live = now or in general: He is said to be ill. to be working = in progress now: He is said to be working abroad. to have left = earlier: He is said to have left in March. to have been working = lasting up to now: She is believed to have been living there for years. For an earlier passive use to have been + past participle: The castle is said to have been built in 1200.

More ways to keep a distance. There is thought to be a fault in the system. He seems / appears to have forgotten. Adverbs: reportedly, allegedly, apparently: The mayor has reportedly resigned. Careful writing: It would appear that the figures are wrong. Prices tend to rise in summer.
qa.tag: There is thought to be, seem, reportedly

qa.html: Typical mistakes: ✗ He is said that he left. → ✓ It is said that he left. or He is said to have left. · ✗ He is said to left. → ✓ He is said to have left. · ✗ It is said him to be rich. → ✓ He is said to be rich.

concept.noteHtml: Register. These structures are mostly written. In speech people say People say he's rich or Apparently, he's rich. Careful with allegedly. It means that nobody has proved the claim, so news writers use it when a crime is involved. Related topics. The passive introduces it is said that. For the words people actually said (She said she was tired) see Reported speech. It is expected to rain looks forward, is thought to have rained looks back. For your own guesses about the past use must have / might have.

hoeren.instruction: Listen and choose what you hear. Listen for the time: now, in progress or earlier.

rounds.label: 1 · Now: it is said that → is said to
rounds.instruction: You hear an impersonal sentence. Say it again with the person or thing as the subject and a to-infinitive.

example.prompt: It is said that she is very rich.
example.answer: She is said to be very rich.

items.prompt: It is believed that he lives in Spain.
items.answer: He is believed to live in Spain.

items.prompt: It is thought that the bridge is unsafe.
items.answer: The bridge is thought to be unsafe.

items.prompt: It is reported that the team is losing money.
items.answer: The team is reported to be losing money.

items.prompt: It is claimed that the drug works.
items.answer: The drug is claimed to work.

items.prompt: It is expected that the talks will end soon.
items.answer: The talks are expected to end soon.

items.prompt: It is understood that she earns a lot.
items.answer: She is understood to earn a lot.

rounds.label: 2 · Earlier: to have + past participle
rounds.instruction: The claim is about the past. Say it with the person or thing as the subject and to have + past participle.

example.prompt: It is said that he left in March.
example.answer: He is said to have left in March.

items.prompt: It is believed that the thief used a ladder.
items.answer: The thief is believed to have used a ladder.

items.prompt: It is thought that the fire started in the kitchen.
items.answer: The fire is thought to have started in the kitchen.

items.prompt: It is reported that the manager resigned.
items.answer: The manager is reported to have resigned.

items.prompt: It is claimed that she won the prize twice.
items.answer: She is claimed to have won the prize twice.

items.prompt: It is said that the castle was built in 1200.
items.answer: The castle is said to have been built in 1200.

items.prompt: It is believed that the painting was stolen last night.
items.answer: The painting is believed to have been stolen last night.
